_about: WOKING 600 SPIDER (600LT Spider): its driver display and its portrait centre screen are blank in the model (quads of the interior's material, their UVs on dark patches of its colour atlas), so each gets a board laid on it, measured from its faces (rays from the driver's eye; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): a digital cluster in McLaren orange, the centre screen's pages (its menu as tabs across the top). Ambient lighting: orange, as its trim. The bottom of its steering wheel (carbon and trim pieces left in the body by the model's cut) is moved onto the wheel (wheel_parts).
